dedupe_keys.name: european truck parking locations kamo update 13 323 sites along the ten t network

description: This dataset lists 13,323 real-world truck parking locations across Europe (EU-27, EFTA and the United Kingdom), filtered for their location along the TEN-T network. The locations come from a previously published set of 19,713 sites, an unpublished set of 32,251 sites and further sources, refined with stakeholder feedback in the KAMO project update (version 4) to add missing sites, increase TEN-T coverage and add planning information that indicates how attractive each location is. It was produced by researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research. Coverage is continental. The data are free under CC BY 4.0 and available to download from Zenodo as a CSV with a codebook, an interactive HTML map and a PDF documentation of methods (January 2025). Caveats: the providers take no liability for completeness, correctness or accuracy, and parking capacity and amenities vary in quality between sources. The dataset aims to help identify sites for megawatt charging of battery-electric trucks and plan charging networks under the EU Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation, and the authors recommend it as candidate locations for coverage or optimisation models. It complements the European long-haul truck charging requirements data and the TEN-T network record.
